how: Exported by hand from Alberta's stocking map. This is the same material fetch_lake_pages.py was written to collect, obtained without the network. scripts/import_stocking_map.py turns it into the CSVs under data/raw/.

notes_from_the_export.2026 data: 2026 is partial-year data as available at extraction. No records in a year does not prove no stocking occurred.
notes_from_the_export.Aeration: Yes means the map description explicitly mentions aeration or the ACA Lake Aeration Program. Not stated does not mean No. None explicitly stated No. Operating status was not independently verified.
notes_from_the_export.Aeration coverage: 12 descriptions explicitly mention aeration. Castaway Trout Pond and Lara Fish Pond have aeration-related photo captions only; their status remains Not stated with the caption evidence recorded.
notes_from_the_export.Coverage: 346 waterbodies, 3,302 individual stocking records, years 2021–2026. This is the history shown on the map, not a claim of complete historical coverage.
notes_from_the_export.Identifiers: Lake IDs are stored as text to preserve their identifier meaning. District is the source label, not an inferred nearest town.
notes_from_the_export.Missing measurements: Unknown is preserved as text, never converted to zero. Known areas and depths are numeric with units in headers.
notes_from_the_export.Page update label: The page footer says Updated: Jul 22, 2025, but its records include 2026. Retrieval date is the export snapshot date.
notes_from_the_export.Photos: 669 original photo URLs and captions, covering 188 waterbodies. 158 waterbodies had no gallery photos. Embedded thumbnails could not be downloaded through the available connection.
notes_from_the_export.Refresh: This file is a static export, not a live connection. Formulas update totals if existing detail values are edited; new records require extending summary groups and formula ranges.
notes_from_the_export.Source discrepancies: Source entries are retained without deduplication or corrections. Similar records on different dates remain separate and contribute to annual totals.
notes_from_the_export.Species enrichment: Angler's Atlas was searched for all 346 names. 176 waterbodies matched; 106 of those have community-listed species, 70 matched pages list none, 28 matches remain uncertain.
notes_from_the_export.Use: Use table header filters for lake, year, species or aeration. Rows with long descriptions can be expanded in Excel. Photo URLs open the original site.
notes_from_the_export.What confirmed means: Atlas listings are community reports, not an official fish survey and not proof of current presence. Disagreement counts are retained and listings the site disputes are excluded from the species columns.
notes_from_the_export.Year grouping: Annual stocking has one row per lake ID, calendar year and species. Totals and event counts are formulas linked to Stocking details.
